name: demo-board
description: Small invented two-page demo used by the tests and goldens: a Home page with a door to a Snacks page. All content is generic placeholder material, not any real user's board. It deliberately exercises every compiler phase: grid setup, button create+label, link-to-new (Home -> Snacks, compiled without --built), link-to-existing (Snacks -> Home, compiled with --built home), a rest cell on each page, style passes (fontSize + symbol-left groups and a fontSize-only group), a silent nav door, a speak-and-navigate door, and a silent label-only button.

pages.title: Demo Home
pages.note: Top page: quick words plus the door to Snacks. Sparse on purpose; the rest cell gives the eyes somewhere safe to land.

buttons.label: snacks
buttons.note: silent door: no speakToo, so the silence phase strips its speak action

pages.title: Demo Snacks
pages.note: Compile with --built home so the door back compiles as link-to-existing (an operator stop).

buttons.label: go back
buttons.note: speak-and-navigate door: keeps its speak action
